name: feature.strategy.nodes
description: Strategy feature node pack — read nodes over the ctx.features.strategy surface (list, get, context, health, check-ins, stale KRs) + a create-board-memo write node that persists an agent-authored board memo as a Document (ctx.features.documents) + the measurement loop: check-in (STRUCTURALLY a proposal from a run — a human confirms in the app), list-check-ins, list-stale-krs (the cadence work list), and sync-metrics (confirmed writes ONLY for KRs whose measure.source a human configured; honest synced/skipped matrix). Strategy CRUD stays human-only.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Strategy: List Strategies
nodes.description: Lists the workspace's shared strategies (compact refs) over ctx.features.strategy. Tenant-guarded; user-scoped private drafts excluded.

nodes.label: Strategy: Get Strategy
nodes.description: Gets one shared strategy by id (objectives, key results, initiatives, links) over ctx.features.strategy. Returns null for a missing or user-scoped strategy.

nodes.label: Strategy: Get Context
nodes.description: Resolves the compact strategy context packet for a consumer ref (projectId | priorityListId[+cardId] | boardId) over ctx.features.strategy. RBAC-bounded; private projects omitted.

nodes.label: Strategy: Get Health
nodes.description: Returns a per-strategy health rollup (on-track/at-risk/off-track) with the component signals over ctx.features.strategy, so an agent can reason about alignment gaps without inventing precision.

nodes.label: Strategy: Create Board Memo
nodes.description: Persists an agent-authored board memo (markdown) as a Document of kind board-update via ctx.features.documents. Degrades to returning the markdown inline when the documents feature is OFF. The strategy surface is never written.

nodes.label: Strategy: Check In on a Key Result
nodes.description: Records a check-in (value and/or note) for a key result (ADR 0231). From a run this is STRUCTURALLY a proposal — it lands status 'proposed' for a human to confirm in the app; mode 'sync' (the metric-sync chain) writes confirmed ONLY against a KR whose measure.source a human configured (refused fail-closed otherwise).

nodes.label: Strategy: List Check-ins
nodes.description: Lists a shared strategy's check-ins, newest first (optionally one key result) — the measurement trail behind the progress rollup (ADR 0231).

nodes.label: Strategy: List Stale Key Results
nodes.description: Measured key results with no confirmed check-in inside the staleness window (default 14 days) across ACTIVE shared strategies — the weekly cadence chain's work list (ADR 0231 §C2).

nodes.label: Strategy: Record a Decision (draft)
nodes.description: Persists an agent-DRAFTED decision record (markdown) as a decision-record Document via ctx.features.documents (ADR 0233). No strategy link is written — links are canonical human writes; a human links the record via POST /strategy/:id/decisions. Degrades to inline markdown when documents is OFF.

nodes.label: Strategy: Sync Sourced Metrics
nodes.description: Syncs every sourced key result from its configured data owner (crm-deal-total, analytics-conversions, commerce-revenue; bigquery composes as a chain upstream) through the one check-in path (ADR 0231 §C3). Returns the synced/skipped matrix — the run output IS the sync-health view.
